_meta.purpose: Companion to palette-mard.json: other fuse-bead brands for cross-reference (screen approximations, not spectrophotometer data).

perler.note: hex sampled/curated by community contributors (Perlervault, BIORIO, ...); codes are Perler item numbers; names are product names

hama.note: same hex also used for Hama Mini (2.5/2 mm) and Maxi (10 mm) subsets in the upstream repo

artkal_s.note: community values (photo-derived): S01 White ~ #EAEEF3 rather than pure white

artkal_c_official.source: HansBug/pindou-color-data artkal-c-197-official/colors.json (from Artkal official 'C MINI Beads RGB Color Chart 2024' PDF; CG/CP/CT specials sampled from the official chart image)
artkal_c_official.license: MIT (data licence text in repo LICENSE)
artkal_c_official.note: official RGB uses pure #FFFFFF/#000000 for white/black: design values, not measurements; CT01-CT09 transparent (alpha 128 is a repo convention, not a physical transmittance)

artkal_m_official.source: HansBug/pindou-color-data artkal-m-221-official/colors.json (Artkal official 'M MINI Beads RGB Color Chart 2025' PDF; Artkal's MARD-compatible 221 set: MA1.. = MARD A1.., MH1 = MARD H1 transparent)
artkal_m_official.license: MIT (data licence text in repo LICENSE)
artkal_m_official.note: useful as an independent manufacturer reference for MARD base 221; median CIEDE2000 distance to MARD web charts is ~5-6
